```c
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT */
/* Conductor: see app.h. Part of fm1-base's unity build, after the platform (gfx.c, announce.c in scope).
 * Protocol: host/conductor/PROTOCOL.md (the numbers below match host/conductor/protocol.py). */
#include "fastmath.h"
#include "hostlink.c"
#include "ledfx.c"
#include "chime.c"

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- protocol --- */
#define CN_VER 1u
enum { T_HELLO_ACK = 0x01, T_CLEAR, T_SLOT, T_DETAIL, T_META, T_FOOTER, T_BEEP };
enum { T_HELLO = 0x41, T_HEARTBEAT, T_ACTION, T_SELECT };
enum { S_EMPTY, S_IDLE, S_WORKING, S_BLOCKED, S_DONE, S_ERROR, S_UNKNOWN, S_N };
enum { OP_APPROVE = 1, OP_ALWAYS, OP_DENY, OP_INTERRUPT, OP_ENTER, OP_CONTINUE, OP_FOCUS, OP_UP, OP_DOWN, OP_MODE };
#define F_QUESTION 0x01u
#define F_REMOTE 0x02u
#define FW_MAJOR 0u
#define FW_MINOR 1u
#define NAME_MAX 20u
#define DETAIL_LINES 8u
#define LINE_MAX 28u

typedef struct {
    uint8_t state, kind, flags, seen;    /* seen: a DONE looked at (selected) since it came */
    uint16_t tag, age;
    char name[NAME_MAX + 1];
} slot_t;

static slot_t slots[NKEYS];
static hostlink_t link;
static struct {
    uint16_t total, hidden;
    char backend[9];
} meta;
static struct {
    uint8_t slot;
    char line[DETAIL_LINES][LINE_MAX + 1];
} detail;
static uint32_t chimes;                  /* figures played since boot (the host simulator's "chimes") */

static const char *const KIND2[] = {"??", "CL", "CX", "OC", "GM", "CU", "PI", "SH"};
static const char *const STATE_WORD[S_N] = {"", "IDLE", "WORK", "WAIT", "DONE", "ERR", "?"};

static uint16_t state_rgb(uint32_t s)
{
    switch (s) {
    case S_IDLE:
        return RGB(200, 200, 206);
    case S_WORKING:
        return RGB(70, 140, 255);
    case S_BLOCKED:
        return RGB(255, 176, 0);
    case S_DONE:
        return RGB(80, 220, 120);
    case S_ERROR:
        return RGB(240, 70, 60);
    default:
        return RGB(120, 120, 128);
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- UI --- */
enum { PG_GRID, PG_DETAIL, PG_APPROVALS, PG_N };
static struct {
    uint8_t page, sel, top;
    uint8_t redraw;
    uint32_t keys, btn;
    char msg[2][24];
    uint32_t msg_until;
    char footer[LINE_MAX + 1];
    uint32_t footer_until;
    uint8_t host_was;
} ui;

static void copy_text(char *d, const uint8_t *s, uint32_t n, uint32_t max)
{
    uint32_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n && i < max; i++)
        d[i] = (s[i] >= 0x20u && s[i] < 0x7Fu) ? (char)s[i] : '?';
    d[i] = 0;
}

static void text_cat(char *d, const char *s)
{
    while (*d)
        d++;
    while (*s)
        *d++ = *s++;
    *d = 0;
}

static void int_text(int32_t v, char *b)
{
    char t[12];
    int n = 0;
    uint32_t u = (uint32_t)(v < 0 ? -v : v);
    do
        t[n++] = (char)('0' + u % 10u);
    while ((u /= 10u) && n < 11);
    if (v < 0)
        *b++ = '-';
    while (n)
        *b++ = t[--n];
    *b = 0;
}

static void note_name(uint32_t key, char *b)   /* key 0 is F3 */
{
    static const char *const N[] = {"C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"};
    uint32_t note = 53u + key;
    b[0] = 0;
    text_cat(b, N[note % 12u]);
    int_text((int32_t)(note / 12u) - 1, b + (b[1] == '#' ? 2 : 1));
}

void app_say(const char *a, const char *b)
{
    uint32_t i;
    char t[48];
    for (i = 0; i < 23u && a && a[i]; i++)
        ui.msg[0][i] = a[i];
    ui.msg[0][i] = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < 23u && b && b[i]; i++)
        ui.msg[1][i] = b[i];
    ui.msg[1][i] = 0;
    ui.msg_until = plat_ms() + 1500u;
    ui.redraw = 1;
    if (ann_on()) {
        t[0] = 0;
        text_cat(t, ui.msg[0]);
        if (ui.msg[1][0]) {
            text_cat(t, " ");
            text_cat(t, ui.msg[1]);
        }
        ann_say(t, 0, ANN_NOW);
    }
}

static int on_page(uint32_t s)            /* slot s is listed on the current page */
{
    if (slots[s].state == S_EMPTY)
        return 0;
    return ui.page != PG_APPROVALS || slots[s].state == S_BLOCKED;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- host in --- */
static void slot_in(const uint8_t *d, uint32_t n)
{
    slot_t *s, old;
    if (n < 8u || d[0] >= NKEYS || d[1] >= S_N)
        return;
    s = &slots[d[0]];
    old = *s;
    s->state = d[1];
    s->kind = d[2] < sizeof KIND2 / sizeof KIND2[0] ? d[2] : 0u;
    s->flags = d[3];
    s->tag = (uint16_t)(d[4] | d[5] << 7);
    s->age = (uint16_t)(d[6] | d[7] << 7);
    copy_text(s->name, d + 8, n - 8u, NAME_MAX);
    if (s->tag != old.tag || s->state != old.state)
        s->seen = d[0] == ui.sel && ui.page != PG_APPROVALS;   /* a DONE on the key we look at is seen */
    /* a chime when an agent we already knew changes: not for the table filling up at a (re)connect */
    if (old.state != S_EMPTY && old.tag == s->tag && old.state != s->state) {
        int f = s->state == S_BLOCKED ? CHIME_UP : s->state == S_DONE ? CHIME_DONE : s->state == S_ERROR ? CHIME_ERROR : -1;
        if (f >= 0 && !chime_busy()) {
            chime_play(f);
            chimes++;
        }
    }
    ui.redraw = 1;
}

int app_sysex(const uint8_t *p, uint32_t n)
{
    uint8_t t;
    uint32_t len, i, now = plat_ms();
    const uint8_t *d = hl_match(&link, p, n, &t, &len);
    if (!d)
        return 0;
    hl_seen(&link, now);
    switch (t) {
    case T_HELLO_ACK:
        hl_acked(&link, now);
        break;
    case T_CLEAR:
        for (i = 0; i < NKEYS; i++)
            slots[i].state = S_EMPTY, slots[i].tag = 0, slots[i].name[0] = 0;
        break;
    case T_SLOT:
        slot_in(d, len);
        break;
    case T_DETAIL:
        if (len >= 2u && d[1] < DETAIL_LINES) {
            detail.slot = d[0];
            copy_text(detail.line[d[1]], d + 2, len - 2u, LINE_MAX);
        }
        break;
    case T_META:
        if (len >= 4u) {
            meta.total = (uint16_t)(d[0] | d[1] << 7);
            meta.hidden = (uint16_t)(d[2] | d[3] << 7);
            copy_text(meta.backend, d + 4, len - 4u, 8);
        }
        break;
    case T_FOOTER:
        copy_text(ui.footer, d, len, LINE_MAX);
        ui.footer_until = now + 3000u;
        break;
    case T_BEEP:
        if (len)
            chime_play(d[0]);
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
    ui.redraw = 1;
    return 1;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- host out --- */
static void send_select(void)
{
    uint8_t s = ui.sel;
    if (hl_host(&link, plat_ms()))
        hl_send(&link, T_SELECT, &s, 1);
}

static void act(uint32_t op)
{
    slot_t *s = &slots[ui.sel];
    uint8_t p[4];
    if (!hl_host(&link, plat_ms())) {
        app_say("NO HOST", "");
        return;
    }
    if (s->state == S_EMPTY) {
        app_say("EMPTY", "");
        return;
    }
    if ((op == OP_APPROVE || op == OP_ALWAYS || op == OP_DENY) && s->state != S_BLOCKED) {
        app_say("NOT WAITING", "");   /* the host checks again; this saves the trip */
        return;
    }
    p[0] = (uint8_t)op;
    p[1] = ui.sel;
    p[2] = (uint8_t)(s->tag & 0x7Fu);
    p[3] = (uint8_t)(s->tag >> 7);
    hl_send(&link, T_ACTION, p, 4);
}

static void select_slot(uint32_t k)
{
    ui.sel = (uint8_t)k;
    if (slots[k].state == S_DONE)
        slots[k].seen = 1;
    send_select();
    ui.redraw = 1;
}

static void step_sel(int32_t d)          /* SELECT: the next slot listed on this page */
{
    uint32_t i, k = ui.sel;
    for (i = 0; i < NKEYS; i++) {
        k = (k + NKEYS + (d > 0 ? 1u : NKEYS - 1u)) % NKEYS;
        if (on_page(k)) {
            select_slot(k);
            return;
        }
    }
}

static void next_attention(void)          /* K4: BLOCKED, then ERROR, then an unseen DONE */
{
    static const uint8_t ORDER[3] = {S_BLOCKED, S_ERROR, S_DONE};
    uint32_t o, i;
    for (o = 0; o < 3u; o++)
        for (i = 1; i <= NKEYS; i++) {
            uint32_t k = (ui.sel + i) % NKEYS;
            if (slots[k].state == ORDER[o] && !(ORDER[o] == S_DONE && slots[k].seen)) {
                select_slot(k);
                return;
            }
        }
    app_say("ALL CLEAR", "");
}

static void set_page(uint32_t p)
{
    ui.page = (uint8_t)(p % PG_N);
    ui.top = 0;
    if (ui.page == PG_DETAIL)
        send_select();
    ui.redraw = 1;
}

static void input(void)
{
    uint32_t keys = plat_keys(), btn = plat_buttons(), k;
    int32_t e;
    for (k = 0; k < NKEYS; k++)
        if ((keys >> k & 1u) && !(ui.keys >> k & 1u))
            select_slot(k);
    for (k = 0; k < NB; k++) {
        if (!(btn >> k & 1u) || (ui.btn >> k & 1u))
            continue;
        switch (k) {
        case B_REC: act(OP_APPROVE); break;
        case B_SAVE: act(OP_ALWAYS); break;
        case B_FX: act(OP_DENY); break;
        case B_ENV: act(OP_INTERRUPT); break;
        case B_SEL: act(OP_ENTER); break;
        case B_PLAY: act(OP_CONTINUE); break;
        case B_LFO: act(OP_MODE); break;
        case B_EDIT:
            set_page(PG_DETAIL);
            act(OP_FOCUS);
            break;
        case B_HOME: set_page(PG_GRID); break;
        case B_GLO: set_page(PG_APPROVALS); break;
        default: break;
        }
    }
    if ((e = plat_enc(EN_SELECT)) != 0)
        step_sel(e);
    if ((e = plat_enc(EN_ALGO)) != 0)
        set_page((uint32_t)((int32_t)ui.page + PG_N + (e > 0 ? 1 : -1)));
    if ((e = plat_enc(EN_K2)) != 0)
        act(e > 0 ? OP_DOWN : OP_UP);
    if ((e = plat_enc(EN_K4)) != 0)
        next_attention();
    (void)plat_enc(EN_PRESET), (void)plat_enc(EN_K1), (void)plat_enc(EN_K3);
    if (keys != ui.keys || btn != ui.btn)
        ui.redraw = 1;
    ui.keys = keys;
    ui.btn = btn;
}

void app_input_only(void) { input(); }

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- lights --- */
static void lights(uint32_t now)
{
    static const uint8_t FX[S_N] = {FX_OFF, FX_GLOW, FX_PULSE, FX_BLINK, FX_LIT, FX_DBLINK, FX_MID};
    ledfx_t kb = {0, 0, 0}, bb = {0, 0, 0};
    uint32_t k, alarm = 0, host = (uint32_t)hl_host(&link, now);
    for (k = 0; k < NKEYS; k++) {
        uint32_t s = slots[k].state;
        int fx = FX[s];
        if (s == S_DONE && slots[k].seen)
            fx = FX_GLOW;
        if (!host && s != S_EMPTY)
            fx = FX_GLOW;                /* stale: we do not know any more */
        ledfx_set(&kb, k, fx, now);
        alarm |= s == S_BLOCKED || s == S_ERROR;
    }
    for (k = 0; k < NB; k++)
        if (k != B_PLAY)
            ledfx_set(&bb, k, FX_GLOW, now);   /* the panel readable in the dark */
    if (slots[ui.sel].state == S_BLOCKED) {
        ledfx_set(&bb, B_REC, FX_BLINK, now);
        ledfx_set(&bb, B_FX, FX_LIT, now);
    }
    /* PLAY, the one LED with colour: red while anyone waits or broke, green while all is well, off with no host */
    if (host)
        bb.lit |= alarm && !host ? 0u : alarm ? 1u << B_PLAY : LED_PLAY_GREEN;
    ledfx_show(&bb, &kb);
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- screen --- */
#define ROW_H 22
#define ROWS 8

static void draw_header(uint32_t now)
{
    char t[24];
    uint32_t k, waiting = 0, working = 0;
    int host = hl_host(&link, now);
    cv_begin(240, 32, C_BLACK);
    if (now < ui.msg_until) {
        int32_t x = cv_text(8, 7, &FONT_B, ui.msg[0], C_WHITE);
        cv_text(x + 8, 7, &FONT_B, ui.msg[1], state_rgb(S_BLOCKED));
    } else {
        static const char *const PAGE[PG_N] = {"AGENTS", "DETAIL", "WAITING"};
        cv_text(8, 7, &FONT_B, PAGE[ui.page], C_WHITE);
        for (k = 0; k < NKEYS; k++) {
            waiting += slots[k].state == S_BLOCKED;
            working += slots[k].state == S_WORKING;
        }
        if (host) {
            int32_t x;
            t[0] = 0;
            int_text((int32_t)waiting, t);
            x = 232 - text_w(&FONT_S, t);
            cv_text(x, 8, &FONT_S, t, waiting ? state_rgb(S_BLOCKED) : C_DIM);
            int_text((int32_t)working, t);
            x -= 10 + text_w(&FONT_S, t);
            cv_text(x, 8, &FONT_S, t, state_rgb(S_WORKING));
            cv_text(x - 6 - text_w(&FONT_XS, meta.backend), 10, &FONT_XS, meta.backend, C_GRAY);
        } else {
            cv_text(232 - text_w(&FONT_XS, "NO HOST"), 10, &FONT_XS, "NO HOST", state_rgb(S_ERROR));
        }
    }
    cv_rect(0, 31, 240, 1, C_LINE);
    cv_blit(0, 0);
}

static void draw_row(uint32_t row, int32_t k)   /* k: the slot, -1 an empty row */
{
    char t[16];
    cv_begin(240, ROW_H, C_BLACK);
    if (k >= 0) {
        const slot_t *s = &slots[k];
        uint16_t c = state_rgb(s->state);
        int sel = (uint32_t)k == ui.sel;
        if (sel)
            cv_rect(0, 0, 240, ROW_H, C_LINE);
        cv_rect(0, 2, 4, ROW_H - 4, c);
        note_name((uint32_t)k, t);
        cv_text(8, 4, &FONT_XS, t, C_GRAY);
        cv_text(36, 4, &FONT_XS, KIND2[s->kind], (s->flags & F_REMOTE) ? state_rgb(S_WORKING) : C_DIM);
        cv_text(56, 4, &FONT_XS, s->name, sel ? C_WHITE : C_AMB);
        t[0] = 0;
        if (s->state == S_BLOCKED || s->state == S_DONE || s->state == S_ERROR || s->age == 0)
            text_cat(t, s->state == S_BLOCKED && (s->flags & F_QUESTION) ? "ASK" : STATE_WORD[s->state]);
        else {
            int_text(s->age, t);
            text_cat(t, "m");
        }
        cv_text(234 - text_w(&FONT_XS, t), 4, &FONT_XS, t, c);
    }
    cv_blit(0, 32 + row * ROW_H);
}

static void draw_list(void)
{
    int32_t list[NKEYS];
    uint32_t n = 0, k, r, at = 0;
    for (k = 0; k < NKEYS; k++)
        if (on_page(k)) {
            if (k == ui.sel)
                at = n;
            list[n++] = (int32_t)k;
        }
    if (at < ui.top)
        ui.top = (uint8_t)at;
    if (at >= ui.top + ROWS)
        ui.top = (uint8_t)(at - ROWS + 1u);
    if (!n) {
        cv_begin(240, ROW_H * ROWS, C_BLACK);
        cv_text(8, 40, &FONT_B, ui.page == PG_APPROVALS ? "ALL CLEAR" : "NO AGENTS", C_GRAY);
        if (!hl_host(&link, plat_ms())) {
            cv_text(8, 70, &FONT_XS, "start the host daemon:", C_DIM);
            cv_text(8, 88, &FONT_XS, "just cond-run hc", C_AMB);
        }
        cv_blit(0, 32);
        return;
    }
    for (r = 0; r < ROWS; r++)
        draw_row(r, ui.top + r < n ? list[ui.top + r] : -1);
}

static void draw_detail(void)
{
    const slot_t *s = &slots[ui.sel];
    char t[24];
    uint32_t i;
    cv_begin(240, ROW_H * ROWS, C_BLACK);
    note_name(ui.sel, t);
    cv_text(8, 2, &FONT_XS, t, C_GRAY);
    if (s->state == S_EMPTY) {
        cv_text(40, 2, &FONT_XS, "EMPTY KEY", C_DIM);
    } else {
        cv_rect(36, 4, 4, 12, state_rgb(s->state));
        cv_text(46, 2, &FONT_XS, KIND2[s->kind], C_DIM);
        cv_text(66, 2, &FONT_XS, s->name, C_WHITE);
        cv_text(234 - text_w(&FONT_XS, STATE_WORD[s->state]), 2, &FONT_XS, STATE_WORD[s->state], state_rgb(s->state));
        if (detail.slot == ui.sel)
            for (i = 0; i < DETAIL_LINES; i++)
                cv_text(4, 24 + (int32_t)i * 18, &FONT_XS, detail.line[i], C_AMB);
    }
    cv_blit(0, 32);
}

static void draw_footer(uint32_t now)
{
    cv_begin(240, 32, C_BLACK);
    cv_rect(0, 0, 240, 1, C_LINE);
    if (now < ui.footer_until)
        cv_text(8, 9, &FONT_XS, ui.footer, C_WHITE);
    else if (meta.hidden) {
        char t[24] = "+";
        int_text(meta.hidden, t + 1);
        text_cat(t, " NOT ON KEYS");
        cv_text(8, 9, &FONT_XS, t, C_GRAY);
    } else
        cv_text(8, 9, &FONT_XS, "REC ok  FX no  ENV stop  K4 next", C_DIM);
    cv_blit(0, 208);
}

static void draw(uint32_t now)
{
    draw_header(now);
    if (ui.page == PG_DETAIL)
        draw_detail();
    else
        draw_list();
    draw_footer(now);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ audio --- */
static float gain_now;

void app_render(int32_t *lr, uint32_t n, uint32_t master_q12)
{
    uint32_t i;
    float gain = (float)master_q12 / 4096.0f * 8300000.0f;
    gain_now += (gain - gain_now) * 0.5f;
    for (i = 0; i < 2u * n; i++)
        lr[i] = 0;
    chime_render(lr, n, gain_now);
}

void app_panic(void) { chime_stop(); }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ the contract --- */
void app_init(void)
{
    uint32_t k;
    hl_init(&link, 0x43, 0x4E, CN_VER);
    for (k = 0; k < NKEYS; k++)
        slots[k].state = S_EMPTY;
}

void app_ui_init(void)
{
    lcd_fill(0, 0, 240, 240, C_BLACK);
    ui.redraw = 1;
}

void app_frame(void)
{
    static const uint8_t HELLO[3] = {CN_VER, FW_MAJOR, FW_MINOR};
    static uint32_t last_msg, last_footer;
    uint32_t now = plat_ms();
    uint8_t host;
    input();
    hl_tick(&link, now, T_HELLO, T_HEARTBEAT, HELLO, 3);
    host = (uint8_t)hl_host(&link, now);
    if (host != ui.host_was) {
        ui.host_was = host;
        ui.redraw = 1;
    }
    /* a message or footer running out */
    if ((ui.msg_until && now >= ui.msg_until) != last_msg || (ui.footer_until && now >= ui.footer_until) != last_footer) {
        last_msg = ui.msg_until && now >= ui.msg_until;
        last_footer = ui.footer_until && now >= ui.footer_until;
        ui.redraw = 1;
    }
    lights(now);
    ann_tick(now);
    if (ui.redraw) {
        ui.redraw = 0;
        draw(now);
    }
}

#ifdef PLAT_HOST
int app_expect(const char *what, int *got)
{
    if (!strcmp(what, "host"))
        *got = hl_host(&link, plat_ms());
    else if (!strcmp(what, "page"))
        *got = ui.page;
    else if (!strcmp(what, "sel"))
        *got = ui.sel;
    else if (!strcmp(what, "total"))
        *got = meta.total;
    else if (!strcmp(what, "chimes"))
        *got = (int)chimes;
    else if (!strncmp(what, "state", 5))
        *got = slots[atoi(what + 5) % NKEYS].state;
    else
        return 0;
    return 1;
}
#endif
```

````markdown
# Conductor protocol, version 1

SysEx over USB-MIDI between `firmware/conductor` (the FM-1) and `host/conductor`
(the daemon). The same frames are meant to go over Bluetooth MIDI later; nothing
in them depends on the transport.

## Framing

```text
F0 7D 43 4E <ver> <type> <payload...> F7
```

- `7D`: the MIDI non-commercial manufacturer ID. `43 4E` ("CN") keeps the frames
  apart from fm1-base's own `7D 4C ..` frames (log, crash history, stats).
- `<ver>` is `01`. A frame with another version is rejected, not guessed at.
- Every payload byte is 7-bit. Numbers above 127 are two bytes, low 7 bits first
  (`u14`). Text is printable ASCII; anything else becomes `?`.
- Frames stay short (at most 36 bytes), so they fit BLE MIDI packets later.

## Host → device

| Type | Name | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `01` | HELLO_ACK | `ver` |
| `02` | CLEAR | — (every slot empty; sent before a full table) |
| `03` | SLOT | `slot` (0–26), `state`, `kind`, `flags`, `tag` u14, `age_min` u14, `name` (≤ 20) |
| `04` | DETAIL | `slot`, `line` (0–7), `text` (≤ 28) |
| `05` | META | `total` u14, `hidden` u14 (agents not on a key), `backend` (≤ 8) |
| `06` | FOOTER | `text` (≤ 28): the result of the last action, shown for 3 s |
| `07` | BEEP | `figure` (0 up, 1 done, 2 error, 3 tick) |

States: `0` EMPTY, `1` IDLE, `2` WORKING, `3` BLOCKED, `4` DONE, `5` ERROR, `6` UNKNOWN.
Kinds: `0` other, `1` claude, `2` codex, `3` opencode, `4` gemini, `5` cursor, `6` pi, `7` shell.
Flags: `01` blocked on a question (not a permission), `02` runs on another machine.

The tag is 14 bits of a CRC of the backend's agent ID. The device echoes it in
every ACTION, so the host can tell whether the agent on that key is still the one
the device was showing.

## Device → host

| Type | Name | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `41` | HELLO | `ver`, `fw_major`, `fw_minor` — once a second until HELLO_ACK |
| `42` | HEARTBEAT | `ver` — once a second after HELLO_ACK |
| `43` | ACTION | `op`, `slot`, `tag` u14 |
| `44` | SELECT | `slot` — the host answers with DETAIL lines for it |

ACTION ops: `1` approve, `2` approve always, `3` deny, `4` interrupt, `5` enter,
`6` continue, `7` focus, `8` up, `9` down, `10` mode (shift+tab).

## Liveness

- The device counts the host as present while any frame arrived in the last
  10 s. The host sends META at least every 3 s as a keepalive.
- On HELLO the host sends HELLO_ACK, CLEAR, every SLOT and META.
- After a new USB session (cable out and in) the device says HELLO again.

## Who decides

The device never decides anything about an agent. It refuses obviously useless
presses locally (approve on a slot that is not BLOCKED) to save a round trip, and
otherwise sends intents. The host re-reads the backend before it presses a key:
the tag must still match the agent on that slot, and the agent's state must fit
the action (approve / deny only when blocked, continue only when idle or done).
There is no auto-approve.

## Shared test vectors

`protocol.py` (`VECTORS`) and `firmware/conductor/tests/basic.txt` use the same
bytes:

| Name | Frame |
|---|---|
| hello_ack | `F0 7D 43 4E 01 01 01 F7` |
| slot_blocked (slot 0, claude, tag `0x123`, 5 min, "fix-tests") | `F0 7D 43 4E 01 03 00 03 01 00 23 02 05 00 66 69 78 2D 74 65 73 74 73 F7` |
| device_approve (slot 0, tag `0x123`) | `F0 7D 43 4E 01 43 01 00 23 02 F7` |

````

````markdown
# firmware/common

Small modules shared by this repo's fm1-base apps. MIT. Each is a `.h` with the
API and usage, and a `.c` that the app includes into fm1-base's unity build.

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| `hostlink` | An app's own SysEx conversation with a program on the computer: framing under `F0 7D id0 id1 ver`, HELLO until the host answers, HEARTBEAT after, host presence with a timeout, a new HELLO after a new USB session. |
| `ledfx` | Per-LED patterns on the single-colour LEDs: off, glow, mid, lit, pulse, blink, double blink, fast. Turns them into `plat_lights` + `plat_lights_mid` once a frame. |
| `chime` | A two-operator FM voice with a short note queue for notification sounds, mixed into the app's render. |

## Using them in an app

`fm1.toml`:

```toml
include = ["../common"]
```

`app.c`, after `#include "fastmath.h"` (chime needs `fm_sinf`, `fm_exp2f`):

```c
#include "hostlink.c"
#include "ledfx.c"
#include "chime.c"
```

They call fm1-base's `plat_*` functions, which are in scope in the unity build.
They keep no flash state.

`firmware/conductor` is the first user; its `tests/basic.txt` exercises all three
in the host simulator.
````

````markdown
# Conductor firmware

The FM-1 as a desk console for coding agents. The keys are agents, their lights
say how urgent each one is, the screen says what it is, a chime says it without
looking. The host daemon in `host/conductor` talks to hc or Herdr.

Design and status (Traditional Chinese): `docs/agentic/conductor.md`.
Protocol: `host/conductor/PROTOCOL.md`. Shared modules: `firmware/common/`.

```sh
just fw-test conductor     # host simulator + tests/basic.txt
just fw-build conductor    # build/conductor.fwsc (USB only, no Bluetooth yet)
just cond-emu              # in fm1-emu with the virtual USB cable; then `just cond-run hc`
```

Not flashed to hardware yet. A flash is a firmware write: owner approval and the
preflight in `AGENTS.md`.

MIT. Built on [fm1-base](https://github.com/charlesvestal/fm1-base) (MPL-2.0).
````

````markdown
# 自己的 agent 控制台：Conductor

Conductor 是我在 [fm1-base](../dev/index.md) 上寫的 agent 控制台：韌體在 `firmware/conductor/`，電腦端的 daemon 在 `host/conductor/`。用過 [Agent Deck](agent-deck.md) 之後，有兩件事想改：shell pane 佔掉大半琴鍵，而且它只接 classic Herdr / tmux。

**狀態（2026-11-17）：設計與原型完成。host simulator、fm1-emu 兩種晶片、daemon 對 hc 的端到端都跑通 `[模擬]`；還沒刷進實機。**

## 一句話的設計

FM-1 的琴鍵 LED 是**單色**的，沒辦法像 Codex Micro 那樣用顏色區分狀態。所以把資訊拆成三層：

| 誰負責 | 表達什麼 | 怎麼表達 |
|---|---|---|
| 琴鍵 LED | 急不急 | 亮度與動態：熄、微亮、中亮、全亮、呼吸、閃爍 |
| 240×240 彩色螢幕 | 是什麼 | 顏色、名稱、狀態字、輸出內容 |
| 提示音 | 不用看也知道 | FM 合成的短音型，`MASTER` 控音量 |

硬體能力 `[上游]`（fm1-base `include/plat.h`）：27 個琴鍵與 14 個按鈕都有 LED，全部單色，每顆可以是 off / glow / mid / lit。**只有 `PLAY` 有紅、綠兩顆 LED。** 閃爍與呼吸都是軟體做的。

## 狀態對應

| 狀態 | 琴鍵 LED | 螢幕色 | 提示音 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 空 | 熄 | — | — |
| IDLE | 微亮 | 白 | — |
| WORKING | 呼吸（微亮 → 中 → 全 → 中，1.6 秒一輪） | 藍 | — |
| BLOCKED（等你） | 2 Hz 閃 | 琥珀 | 上行兩音 |
| DONE（還沒看） | 全亮；選過之後轉微亮 | 綠 | 三音和弦 |
| ERROR | 每 1.2 秒雙閃 | 紅 | 下行兩音 |
| UNKNOWN | 中亮 | 灰 | — |

- **`PLAY` 是總覽燈**：有任何 BLOCKED / ERROR 時亮紅，全部正常時亮綠，沒有 host 時熄。
- 螢幕的顏色沿用 Codex Micro 的白 / 藍 / 綠 / 琥珀 / 紅，看過那台的人不用重學。
- 提示音只在**已知的 agent 換狀態**時響，剛連上、整張表填進來時不響；同時很多個換狀態只響一次。
- host 斷線 10 秒後，螢幕右上角顯示 `NO HOST`，琴鍵全部退成微亮，表示「這些狀態已經不可靠」。

## 控制

| 控制 | 動作 |
|---|---|
| 琴鍵 | 選那個 agent（每個琴鍵固定一個 agent，換頁不會跑掉） |
| **SELECT** | 在目前頁面列出的 agent 之間移動 |
| **KNOB 4** | 跳到下一個需要你的：BLOCKED → ERROR → 還沒看的 DONE |
| `REC` | approve |
| `SAVE` | approve 並不再詢問（只對有設定按鍵的 agent 種類） |
| `FX` | deny（Esc） |
| `ENV` | interrupt |
| `SEL` | Enter |
| `PLAY` | 送 `continue`（只對 IDLE / DONE） |
| `LFO` | 切換 agent 的 mode（Shift+Tab） |
| **KNOB 2** | 上 / 下方向鍵 |
| `EDIT` | DETAIL 頁（classic Herdr 下同時 focus 那個 pane） |
| `HOME` / `GLO` | 全部 agent / 只列等你的 |
| **ALGORITHM** | 輪流切換三個頁面 |

按鈕的位置沿用 Agent Deck，換過來不用重新記。**預設只有 agent 會佔琴鍵，shell 不會**：hc 只放有回報狀態或前景是已知 agent 的 terminal，classic Herdr 用 `agent.list`（它本來就只列 agent）。我的 classic Herdr 當下有 48 個 pane，`agent.list` 是 20 個，27 鍵放得下 `[實機]` host 端。放不下的數量顯示在底部（`+N NOT ON KEYS`）。

琴鍵和 agent 的對應存在 host 的 `~/.config/conductor/slots-<backend>.json`，agent 重開會回到原本的鍵。

## 架構

```text
FM-1  firmware/conductor（fm1-base app，MIT）
   ⇅  USB-MIDI SysEx：F0 7D 43 4E …（協定 v1）
host/conductor（Python daemon）
   ├─ hc      → `hc connect`（JSON-RPC 2.0）、events.subscribe
   ├─ herdr   → classic Herdr 的 unix socket、events.subscribe
   └─ fake    → 測試與 demo
```

協定規格在 `host/conductor/PROTOCOL.md`。幾個決定：

- **用真正的 SysEx。** Agent Deck 把資料塞進 CC，是因為它的基底 Dinghy 把 SysEx 留給更新程式；fm1-base 讓 app 收發 SysEx（`APP_SYSEX`、`plat_sysex_send`）`[上游]`。前綴 `7D 43 4E` 避開 fm1-base 自己的 `7D 4C ..`。
- **裝置只送意圖，host 再確認一次。** 裝置送 `ACTION(op, slot, tag)`；host 送鍵前重新讀一次 backend：tag 要還是那個鍵上的 agent，狀態也要對（approve / deny 只對 BLOCKED，continue 只對 IDLE / DONE）。避免「剛好換了一個 agent 到這個鍵上」時批准錯對象。
- **沒有 auto-approve。**
- **韌體不寫 flash。** 所有狀態都在 host；fm1-emu 裡兩種晶片都是 0 次 erase / program `[模擬]`。韌體只登記 fm1-base 必要的 panel calibration 物件（`0xDC000`），不用 SLOOP 的設定 sector `0xFC000`。
- **授權**：`firmware/conductor`、`firmware/common`、`host/conductor` 都是 MIT。沒有複製 Agent Deck（GPL-3.0）的程式碼，只參考它的按鍵配置與行為。

### 為什麼 hc 優先 { #backends }

| | hc（herdr-core 0.1.21） | classic Herdr 0.9.5 |
|---|---|---|
| 狀態從哪來 | agent 自己用 OSC 7501 回報；Claude Code、Codex 原生會送；hc 從不猜 `[上游]` | 程序偵測 + 畫面比對，或 integration 回報 `[上游]` |
| 列出 agent | `terminal.list`；沒回報狀態的當 shell | `agent.list`，只有 agent |
| approve / deny | `terminal.keys`（沒有專用 method） | `pane.send_keys` |
| interrupt | `terminal.interrupt`，會回報結果 | 送 Esc |
| 送 prompt | `terminal.send`，BLOCKED 時拒絕 | `agent.prompt` |
| focus pane | 沒有 | `pane.focus` |
| 遠端機器 | `hc machine add`，遠端 terminal 出現在同一份清單 | 沒有 |

兩個是**各自獨立的 runtime**，不共享 agent。我目前每天用的是 classic Herdr，所以兩個 backend 都做：hc 的狀態比較準、能接遠端機器，classic Herdr 能 focus pane。

## 為什麼不走 Codex Micro { #codex-micro }

[scf4/codex-midi](https://github.com/scf4/codex-midi) 把 MIDI controller 偽裝成 OpenAI × Work Louder 的 Codex Micro。我讀過它的原始碼 `[上游]`，決定不當主線：

- 它用 `NODE_OPTIONS=--require=…` 啟動 ChatGPT.app，在 Electron 的 main process 裡攔截 `node-hid`，插入一個假裝置。每次都要先完全關掉 ChatGPT，再從它的 launcher 開。
- 協定（`v.oai.thstatus`、`v.oai.rgbcfg` 的 64-byte HID report 裡的 JSON-RPC）是逆向工程得來，只對 ChatGPT `26.715.31925` 測過，沒有版本檢查，app 更新後可能**無聲地**失效。
- task 狀態只以 **RGB 顏色**傳給裝置，沒有「thinking」這種狀態字。FM-1 的單色 LED 收到顏色也還原不出狀態，螢幕也拿不到 task 名稱。
- 只有 6 個 task 槽，只控制 macOS 桌面版 ChatGPT 裡的 Codex，不碰 Codex CLI。

要接 Codex，比較穩的路是官方有文件的 [`codex app-server`](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server.md)（JSON-RPC，有 approval request 與 turn 事件）`[上游]`。它會是之後的第三個 backend，不需要改韌體。

## USB 與 Bluetooth { #bluetooth }

FM-1 的晶片有 Bluetooth，fm1-base 也支援 BLE MIDI（`ble = true`）`[上游]`。協定不挑傳輸方式，frame 都在 36 bytes 以內，BLE 封包裝得下。**目前的 build 只開 USB**（`fm1.toml` 的 `ble = false`），原因是：

- fm1-base 文件寫明 `app_sysex` 收的是「從 USB 來的 SysEx」。BLE 送 SysEx 有路（packet 化後 `plat_midi_send`，或 `plat_ble_stream`），**從 BLE 收 SysEx 給 app 的路徑文件裡沒寫清楚** `[上游]`。要先在 host simulator 與 fm1-emu 確認再做。
- BLE 配對要存 bond（fm1-base 的 `OBJ_BLE`），會開始寫 flash；USB 版完全不寫。

預計的 Bluetooth 設計（還沒實作）：

| 項目 | 設計 |
|---|---|
| 模式 | 插 USB 且有電腦時走 USB；按住 `REC` 1 秒切換 Bluetooth 開 / 關（和 fm1-base template 相同的手勢） |
| 配對 | FM-1 廣播 BLE MIDI；macOS 第一次在 **Audio MIDI 設定 → MIDI Studio → Bluetooth 設定** 按「連接」。之後 CoreMIDI 出現一個名字含 `CONDUCTOR` 的 port，daemon 用同一段程式找到它（`host/conductor/device.py` 的 `MidiLink` 不分 USB / BLE） |
| 螢幕 | 標頭顯示 `USB` / `BLE ADV`（廣播中）/ `BLE`（已連線）；配對碼（若有）顯示在螢幕上 |
| 兩條都在時 | daemon 優先選 USB 那個 port |
| 安全 | 連上一台之後停止廣播。裝置只送意圖，真正按鍵的是電腦上的 daemon，且會再確認；陌生的電腦連上也拿不到任何 agent 的控制權 |
| 好處 | 拔掉線用電池當無線控制台，這是 Agent Deck 做不到的（它的基底沒有藍牙程式） |

## 共用模組 { #common }

給之後其他韌體用的部分放在 `firmware/common/`（MIT），app 在 `fm1.toml` 加 `include = ["../common"]`，再在 `app.c` include `.c` 檔：

| 模組 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `hostlink` | app 自己的 SysEx 對話：frame 前綴、HELLO 直到 host 回應、之後 HEARTBEAT、host 是否還在、重新插線後重新 HELLO |
| `ledfx` | 單色 LED 的動態：off / glow / mid / lit / 呼吸 / 閃 / 雙閃 / 快閃，每 frame 轉成 `plat_lights` + `plat_lights_mid` |
| `chime` | 兩個 operator 的 FM 小音色加上音符佇列，混進 app 的 render，做提示音 |

說明與用法在 `firmware/common/README.md`。

## 指令

```sh
just cond-test              # daemon 的單元測試（協定、slot 記憶、動作確認）
just cond-sim               # daemon 對 fake backend，裝置用 terminal 文字代替
just cond-sim hc            # 同上，接真的 hc
just cond-it                # hc 端到端：開兩個假 agent，approve / deny / continue，再關掉
just fw-test conductor      # 韌體在 host simulator 跑 tests/basic.txt
just fw-build conductor     # 實機套件 firmware/conductor/build/conductor.fwsc
just cond-emu               # 韌體在 fm1-emu，插虛擬 USB
just cond-run hc            # daemon 接 MIDI 裝置（模擬器或實機）
```

`cond-sim` 裡可以打 `sel N`、`approve`、`deny`、`int`、`cont`、`show`、`quit`。

daemon 的設定檔是 `~/.config/conductor/config.json`（可省略），可以改各種 agent 的按鍵，例如：

```json
{"approve_always_keys": {"claude": ["2"], "codex": ["a"]}}
```

## 驗證結果

| 項目 | 結果 | 標記 |
|---|---|---|
| `just cond-test` | 15 項通過 | — |
| `just cond-it`（hc） | 兩個假 agent 上了琴鍵，既有的兩個 zsh 沒有；approve 送到 Enter、deny 送到 Esc、continue 送到文字；結束後只清掉自己的 terminal | `[實機]` host 端 |
| classic Herdr（唯讀） | `agent.list` 20 個 agent、`pane.read` 讀得到輸出；**沒有對 classic Herdr 送過任何鍵** | `[實機]` host 端 |
| `just fw-test conductor` | 全部 `ok`：HELLO、HELLO_ACK、SLOT、REC 送出 approve、對 WORKING 按 REC 被拒、提示音只在換狀態時響、K4、三個頁面、10 秒後 `NO HOST` | `[模擬]` host simulator |
| `just fw-build conductor` | app 85,356 B；RAM `.data+.bss` 26,084 / 98,304 B；build 自帶檢查全部 `ok` | — |
| fm1-emu `uc25hq80` / `p25q80` | 都列舉成 USB `CONDUCTOR FM-1`、每秒 HELLO、收到 HELLO_ACK 後改送 HEARTBEAT、畫面正確；**flash 0 次 erase / program** | `[模擬]` |
| daemon ↔ fm1-emu（虛擬 USB） | daemon 經 CoreMIDI 找到 `CONDUCTOR FM-1 (emu)`，收到 HELLO 並送出整張表 | `[模擬]` |
````

```bash
"""Several backends at once: hc and classic Herdr are separate runtimes, and the agents
may live in either. IDs get the backend's name in front ("hc:t7", "herdr:wV:p1")."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time

from ..model import Agent
from .base import BackendError


class MultiBackend:
    def __init__(self, backends: list):
        if not backends:
            raise BackendError("no backend available")
        self.backends = {b.name: b for b in backends}
        self.name = "+".join(self.backends)[:8]

    def _split(self, agent_id: str):
        name, _, inner = agent_id.partition(":")
        if name not in self.backends:
            raise BackendError(f"no backend for {agent_id}")
        return self.backends[name], inner

    def list_agents(self) -> list[Agent]:
        out = []
        for name, b in self.backends.items():
            try:
                agents = b.list_agents()
            except BackendError:
                continue  # one runtime down does not hide the other's agents
            for a in agents:
                a.id = f"{name}:{a.id}"
                out.append(a)
        return out

    def read_lines(self, agent_id, n):
        b, i = self._split(agent_id)
        return b.read_lines(i, n)

    def keys(self, agent_id, keys):
        b, i = self._split(agent_id)
        b.keys(i, keys)

    def send_text(self, agent_id, text):
        b, i = self._split(agent_id)
        b.send_text(i, text)

    def interrupt(self, agent_id):
        b, i = self._split(agent_id)
        return b.interrupt(i)

    def focus(self, agent_id):
        b, i = self._split(agent_id)
        return b.focus(i)

    def wait_change(self, timeout: float) -> bool:
        end = time.time() + timeout
        step = max(timeout / (2 * len(self.backends)), 0.02)
        while True:
            for b in self.backends.values():
                if b.wait_change(step):
                    return True
            if time.time() >= end:
                return False

    def close(self) -> None:
        for b in self.backends.values():
            b.close()
EOF
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-17 10:03:38Z)**_

沒有壞掉，是 backend 選錯了地方。你跑的 `just cond-run hc` 只看 hc，你的 hc 裡只有兩個 `zsh`，而 shell 我設計成不佔琴鍵，所以顯示 `NO AGENTS`。你的 agent 都在 classic Herdr。第三張有畫面的圖，是我之前用 fake backend 測試時的畫面。

這樣預設確實容易誤會，所以改了三件事：

- **`--backend` 預設改成 `auto`**：hc 和 classic Herdr 哪個在跑就接哪個，兩邊的 agent 合在一起，標頭顯示 `hc+herdr`。`just cond-run` 不帶參數就是 `auto`。
- **啟動時印出每個 backend 看到什麼**，空畫面的原因直接寫在 terminal 上：
  ```text
  [backend] hc: 0 agents, 2 shells not shown (--show-shells to list them)
  [backend] herdr: 20 agents
  ```
- **agent 名稱可以正常顯示了**：螢幕只顯示 ASCII，之前 Herdr 標題裡的 `●` 和中文都變成 `?`。現在會去掉開頭的狀態符號；標題大多不是 ASCII 時改用目錄名稱。

我用 `auto` 對你的真實環境只讀跑了一次，沒有送任何鍵：20 個 agent 都上了琴鍵，名稱正確，有兩個是 WORKING。`just cond-test` 現在 17 項全過。

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-17 10:11:54Z)**_

對，`just cond-run hc` 讀的是 hc 裡真實的 agent 狀態。你截圖裡在 Herdr app 開的 Claude Code，自己回報了 `app=claude-code`、`state=done`，所以 F3 顯示 DONE、琴鍵亮著。

模擬的 agent 也有，只是要另外指定：

| 跑法 | agent 從哪來 | 按鍵送到哪 |
|---|---|---|
| `just cond-run fake`、`just cond-sim` | daemon 內建的 5 個 demo agent | 哪裡都不送，只記錄 |
| `just cond-it` | 在 hc 裡開兩個假 agent 程序，它們會像 Claude Code 一樣回報狀態；測完自動關掉 | 只送給那兩個假 agent |
| `just cond-run`、`cond-run hc`、`cond-run herdr` | **你真實的 session** | **真的 Claude Code、Codex** |

所以你現在在模擬器視窗按的 `REC`、`FX`、`ENV`，都會真的作用在那個 Claude Code 上。只想試按鍵、不想動到真的 session，就用 `just cond-run fake`。

你截圖裡種類欄顯示 `??`，我查了，是兩個對應漏掉了：Claude Code 回報的名稱是 `claude-code`，不是 `claude`；你又是用 `specstory run claude` 啟動，所以前景程式是 `specstory`。現在兩種都認得了，`specstory run claude` 這類 wrapper 會從 argv 裡找出真正的 agent。重跑 `just cond-run hc`，那一列就會顯示 `CL`。`just cond-test` 現在 18 項全過。

`docs/agentic/conductor.md` 加了「假的還是真的 agent」一節，就是上面這張表，`just docs-check` 通過。

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```python
"""A dictation hotkey held down from the FM-1: the daemon presses keys on this Mac as
if from the keyboard, so Wispr Flow, Handy or macOS Dictation start listening.

Hold mode (push-to-talk): key down while the device's button is held, up on release.
Toggle mode: a quick press and release on the button's press (for apps that toggle).
The keys are always let go: on release, after max_hold seconds, when the device
restarts, and when the daemon exits. Needs Accessibility permission for the app the
daemon runs in (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import ctypes.util
import sys
import time

# macOS virtual key codes and the event flags each modifier sets
KEYCODES = {
    "ctrl": 0x3B, "control": 0x3B, "rctrl": 0x3E,
    "option": 0x3A, "alt": 0x3A, "ropt": 0x3D, "roption": 0x3D,
    "cmd": 0x37, "command": 0x37, "rcmd": 0x36,
    "shift": 0x38, "rshift": 0x3C,
    "fn": 0x3F,
    "space": 0x31, "return": 0x24, "escape": 0x35, "tab": 0x30,
    "f5": 0x60, "f6": 0x61, "f13": 0x69, "f14": 0x6B, "f15": 0x71, "f16": 0x6A, "f17": 0x40,
    "f18": 0x4F, "f19": 0x50,
}
FLAGS = {
    "ctrl": 0x40000, "control": 0x40000, "rctrl": 0x40000,
    "option": 0x80000, "alt": 0x80000, "ropt": 0x80000, "roption": 0x80000,
    "cmd": 0x100000, "command": 0x100000, "rcmd": 0x100000,
    "shift": 0x20000, "rshift": 0x20000,
    "fn": 0x800000,
}


class MacKeys:
    """CGEventPost through ctypes: no extra Python package needed."""

    def __init__(self):
        if sys.platform != "darwin":
            raise OSError("voice key: macOS only")
        cg = ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary(ctypes.util.find_library("CoreGraphics") or ctypes.util.find_library("ApplicationServices"))
        cf = ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary(ctypes.util.find_library("CoreFoundation"))
        cg.CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        cg.CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint16, ctypes.c_bool]
        cg.CGEventSetFlags.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint64]
        cg.CGEventPost.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_void_p]
        cf.CFRelease.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        self.cg, self.cf = cg, cf

    def post(self, keycode: int, down: bool, flags: int) -> None:
        e = self.cg.CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, keycode, down)
        self.cg.CGEventSetFlags(e, flags)
        self.cg.CGEventPost(0, e)  # kCGHIDEventTap: seen like the real keyboard
        self.cf.CFRelease(e)


def accessibility_trusted() -> bool | None:
    """True / False on macOS; None where it cannot be asked."""
    if sys.platform != "darwin":
        return None
    try:
        ax = ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary(ctypes.util.find_library("ApplicationServices"))
        ax.AXIsProcessTrusted.restype = ctypes.c_bool
        return bool(ax.AXIsProcessTrusted())
    except OSError:
        return None


class VoiceKey:
    def __init__(self, keys: list[str], mode: str = "hold", max_hold: float = 120.0, poster=None):
        bad = [k for k in keys if k.lower() not in KEYCODES]
        if bad or not keys:
            raise ValueError(f"voice keys not known: {bad or keys}")
        self.keys = [k.lower() for k in keys]
        self.mode = mode
        self.max_hold = max_hold
        self.poster = poster
        self.held_since: float | None = None

    def _poster(self):
        if self.poster is None:
            self.poster = MacKeys()
        return self.poster

    def _down(self):
        p, flags = self._poster(), 0
        for k in self.keys:
            flags |= FLAGS.get(k, 0)
            p.post(KEYCODES[k], True, flags)

    def _up(self):
        p = self._poster()
        flags = 0
        for k in self.keys:
            flags |= FLAGS.get(k, 0)
        for k in reversed(self.keys):
            flags &= ~FLAGS.get(k, 0)
            p.post(KEYCODES[k], False, flags)

    def press(self) -> str:
        if self.mode == "toggle":
            self._down()
            self._up()
            return "VOICE"
        if self.held_since is None:
            self._down()
            self.held_since = time.time()
        return "LISTENING"

    def release(self) -> str:
        if self.mode == "toggle":
            return ""
        self.let_go()
        return "VOICE OFF"

    def let_go(self) -> None:
        """Never leave the keys down."""
        if self.held_since is not None:
            self.held_since = None
            self._up()

    def tick(self, now: float | None = None) -> None:
        if self.held_since is not None and (now or time.time()) - self.held_since > self.max_hold:
            self.let_go()

```

```bash
class _Keys:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def post(self, code, down, flags):
        self.events.append((code, down, flags))


def test_voice_hold_presses_and_always_lets_go(tmp_path):
    from conductor.voice import VoiceKey

    be, sim, c = setup(tmp_path)
    keys = _Keys()
    c.voice = VoiceKey(["ctrl", "option"], poster=keys)
    press(sim, c, f"sel {c.slots.slot_of('f2')}")

    assert keys.events == [(0x3B, True, 0x40000), (0x3A, True, 0xC0000)]
    assert ("f2", "focus", None) in be.sent  # the agent's pane first, so the words land there
    (out,) = press(sim, c, "unvoice")
    assert keys.events[2:] == [(0x3A, False, 0x40000), (0x3B, False, 0)]
    # held, then the device restarts: let go
    press(sim, c, "voice")
    sim.q.put(P.device_hello())
    for f in sim.poll():
        c.on_frame(f)
    assert keys.events[-1] == (0x3B, False, 0) and c.voice.held_since is None


def test_voice_times_out_and_toggle_mode():
    from conductor.voice import VoiceKey

    keys = _Keys()
    v = VoiceKey(["f19"], max_hold=5, poster=keys)
    v.press()
    v.tick(v.held_since + 6)
    assert keys.events[-1] == (0x50, False, 0) and v.held_since is None
    t = VoiceKey(["option", "space"], mode="toggle", poster=_Keys())
    t.press()
    assert [d for _, d, _ in t.poster.events] == [True, True, False, False]
    assert t.release() == ""
```

````markdown
## 琴鍵的燈

| 燈 | 意思 | 螢幕色 |
|---|---|---|
| 熄 | 這個鍵沒有 agent | — |
| 微亮 | IDLE，閒著 | 白 |
| 呼吸（慢慢亮暗） | WORKING | 藍 |
| **2 Hz 閃** | **BLOCKED：等你批准或回答** | 琥珀 |
| 全亮 | DONE，還沒看；選過之後轉微亮 | 綠 |
| 雙閃 | ERROR | 紅 |
| 中亮 | UNKNOWN | 灰 |

全部退成微亮、右上角 `NO HOST`：daemon 斷了，燈的狀態不可靠。提示音：上行兩音 = 有人在等，三音和弦 = 完成，下行兩音 = 出錯。

## 回答 agent

先選 agent（按它的琴鍵，或轉 SELECT），再按：

| 按 | 動作 | 只在 |
|---|---|---|
| `REC` | 批准（Enter，選預設的 Yes） | BLOCKED |
| `SAVE` | 批准且不再問 | BLOCKED，且設定了按鍵（Claude、Codex） |
| `FX` | 拒絕（Esc） | BLOCKED |
| `ENV` | 中斷這一輪 | 任何時候 |
| `SEL` | Enter | 任何時候 |
| `PLAY` | 送 `continue` | IDLE、DONE |
| `LFO` | 切 mode（Shift+Tab） | 任何時候 |
| KNOB 2 | 選單裡上下移動 | 任何時候 |

選取的 agent 在等你時，`REC` 會閃、`FX` 會亮。daemon 送鍵前會再確認一次那個鍵上還是同一個 agent、它真的在等；不是的話底部會顯示 `CHANGED, LOOK AGAIN` 或 `NOT WAITING`，什麼都不送。

## 移動

| 按 | 動作 |
|---|---|
| 琴鍵 | 選那個 agent |
| SELECT | 在這頁列出的 agent 之間上下移 |
| KNOB 4 | 跳到下一個需要你的：BLOCKED → ERROR → 還沒看的 DONE |
| `HOME` | 全部 agent |
| `GLO` | 只列在等你的 |
| `EDIT` | 選取 agent 的細節（輸出最後 8 行）；classic Herdr 下同時在電腦上 focus 那個 pane |
| ALGORITHM | 三頁輪流 |

## 語音輸入：按住 `ARP`

**按住 `ARP` 說話，放開結束。** daemon 在這台 Mac 上模擬按住 `Ctrl`+`Option`，和 Wispr Flow 的 push-to-talk 一樣。放開後辨識出來的文字會打進目前 focus 的視窗；能 focus 的 backend（classic Herdr）會先把選取 agent 的 pane 叫到前面。

設定：

1. Wispr Flow（或 Handy）的快捷鍵設成 `Ctrl`+`Option`（或改下面的 `voice_keys` 去配合它）。
2. 跑 daemon 的那個 terminal app 要有**輔助使用**權限：系統設定 → 隱私權與安全性 → 輔助使用。沒有的話 daemon 啟動時會提醒，按鍵也送不到。
3. 別的組合寫在 `~/.config/conductor/config.json`：

```json
{"voice_keys": ["ctrl", "option"], "voice_mode": "hold"}
```

`voice_mode` 是 `hold`（按住說、放開停）或 `toggle`（按一下開始、再按一下停，給用切換式快捷鍵的 app）。按鍵名稱：`ctrl`、`option`、`cmd`、`shift`、`fn`、右側的 `rctrl` / `ropt` / `rcmd` / `rshift`，以及 `space`、`f13`–`f19` 等。不想要這個功能：`just cond-run --no-voice`。

安全：按住超過 120 秒、裝置重開、daemon 結束時，daemon 一定會放開按鍵，不會讓 `Ctrl` 卡住。

## 沒有 FM-1 時：文字版

`just cond-sim`（或 `just cond-sim auto`）用 terminal 代替裝置：

| 打 | 等於 |
|---|---|
| `sel N` | 按第 N 個琴鍵（0 = F3） |
| `approve` / `always` / `deny` | `REC` / `SAVE` / `FX` |
| `int` / `enter` / `cont` | `ENV` / `SEL` / `PLAY` |
| `focus` | `EDIT` 的 focus |
| `voice` / `unvoice` | 按下 / 放開 `ARP` |
| `show` | 看細節的 8 行 |
| `quit` | 離開 |

## 和 Agent Deck 的差別

按鈕位置大致相同，換過來不用重記。不同的地方：

- shell 不佔琴鍵；一個 agent 固定一個鍵，沒有換頁。
- 沒有 auto-approve、prompt preset、`GLO` + 按鈕的「全部一起」；`ARP` 改成語音。
- 提示音與 `PLAY` 的總覽燈是新的。
````

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-17 10:21:06Z)**_

兩個都做好了。語音鍵已有測試驗證，但還沒對真的 Wispr Flow 觸發過，要你在自己的 terminal 試一次。

**1. 速查頁** `docs/agentic/conductor-cheatsheet.md`（已加進 nav）

Agent Deck 那頁只有文字，我加了一張面板對照圖：每顆旋鈕和按鈕都標上 Conductor 裡的功能，並依用途上色（琥珀＝回答 agent、藍＝操作、灰＝移動、綠＝語音、虛線＝沒用到）。我用 Quick Look 把圖轉成 PNG 看過，排版正確；網站上淺色和深色主題的實際顯示沒有檢查。圖下面依序是三步開始、琴鍵燈號表、回答 agent、移動、語音輸入、沒有 FM-1 時的文字版，以及和 Agent Deck 的差別。設計頁也加了連結。

**2. 語音鍵：按住 `ARP`**

- **怎麼用**：按住 `ARP` 開始說話，放開就停。daemon 會在 Mac 上模擬按住 `Ctrl`+`Option`，等於 Wispr Flow 的 push-to-talk。按住時 `ARP` 的燈會亮，螢幕顯示 `LISTENING`。
- **文字打到哪**：打進目前 focus 的視窗。classic Herdr 會先把選取的 agent 的 pane 叫到前面，hc 不能 focus，文字會打到你當下 focus 的地方。
- **換組合**：在 `~/.config/conductor/config.json` 設定，例如給 Handy 用：
  ```json
  {"voice_keys": ["option", "space"], "voice_mode": "toggle"}
  ```
  `hold` 是按住說，`toggle` 是按一下開始、再按一下停。
- **不會卡鍵**：按住超過 120 秒、裝置重開、daemon 結束時，一定會放開 `Ctrl`、`Option`。
- **驗證**：`just cond-test` 20 項通過，涵蓋送出的按鍵、超時和重開時放開；韌體的 host simulator 測試也通過，實機套件已重新 build。

**你要做的一件事**：跑 daemon 的那個 terminal app 要有輔助使用權限（系統設定 → 隱私權與安全性 → 輔助使用）。沒有的話模擬出來的按鍵送不到，daemon 啟動時會提醒。我這邊的 shell 就沒有這個權限，所以無法替你實測。

**怎麼試**：模擬器要關掉重開 `just cond-emu`，才會載入新版韌體；然後重跑 `just cond-run`，在模擬器視窗按住 `ARP`（鍵盤數字鍵對應功能鍵，用滑鼠按住 `ARP` 最直接）。不想要這個功能就用 `just cond-run --no-voice`。

```bash
Add Conductor: own agent-console firmware and host daemon

firmware/conductor is an fm1-base app (MIT) that turns the FM-1 into a
console for coding agents: one agent per key, urgency on the
single-colour key LEDs (glow, pulse, blink, double blink), state and
names on the screen, FM chimes on state changes, PLAY as a red/green
overview light, and ARP held as a push-to-talk dictation key.

PROTOCOL.md) where the device sends intents and the host re-checks
the agent and its state before pressing any key. No auto-approve.

firmware/common holds modules for later apps: hostlink, ledfx, chime.

Tested in the host simulator, in fm1-emu on both flash chips (no flash
writes), daemon to emulator over virtual USB, and hc end to end with
fake agents. Not flashed to hardware.

Docs: design page, cheatsheet with a panel diagram, research on
codex-midi and hc vs classic Herdr.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
```

```text
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

        echo
        echo "named targets:"
        for t in "sloop=downloads/sloop-{{sloop_version}}.fwsc" "agtdeck=downloads/agtdeck-{{agtdeck_version}}.fwsc" \
                 "ctl=downloads/ctl-{{ctl_version}}.fwsc" "choralroot=downloads/{{choralroot_pkg}}" \
                 "remote=downloads/remote-{{remote_version}}.fwsc"; do

        done

      choralroot) pkg="downloads/{{choralroot_pkg}}" ;;

    esac
```

```text
{"schema": 1, "id": "conductor", "name": "fm1-base", "author": "daviddwlee84", "license": "MIT", "tagline": "a desk console for coding agents", "description": "The keys are your coding agents: their lights say who needs you, the screen says what they are doing, a chime tells you without looking. Talks to hc or Herdr through a host daemon over USB-MIDI.", "tags": ["utility"], "source": "https://github.com/daviddwlee84/M-VAVE_FM-1", "hardware": {"models": ["FM-1"], "flash": ["856014", "B36014"], "features": ["usb-audio-in", "usb-audio-out", "screen-reader"]}, "credits": "Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal."}
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build an emulator flash image that rehearses installing a firmware over a real backup.

M-Flasher writes a package's image and leaves the rest of the flash as it was (for
SLOOP, Agent Deck and CTL-1 on my unit: 0x04000-0x92FFF). This does the same on a
copy: take a full-flash backup, lay the package's image over it, and write the result
as an fm1-live --flash file. Booting it in the emulator shows how the new firmware
reacts to the data the old one left behind, without touching the unit.

Limits: the package image is taken as the contiguous run from 0x04000 in what the
emulator lays down; whether M-Flasher writes exactly that range for a given
package is only known from its own plan. The emulator is not the hardware.

usage: emu_rehearse.py PRISTINE.flash BACKUP.bin OUT.flash
  PRISTINE.flash  what fm1-live writes for the package on an empty flash
"""
import sys

FW_START = 0x04000
SECTOR = 4096
BLANK = b"\xff" * SECTOR


def main():
    pristine = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
    backup = open(sys.argv[2], "rb").read()
    if len(pristine) != len(backup) or len(backup) != 1 << 20:
        sys.exit("both images must be 1 MiB")
    # the package's image: the contiguous run from the start of the firmware area
    # (0x92FFF for most firmwares, further for larger ones such as ChoralRoot)
    end = FW_START
    while end < len(pristine) and pristine[end:end + SECTOR] != BLANK:
        end += SECTOR
    image = backup[:FW_START] + pristine[FW_START:end] + backup[end:]
    open(sys.argv[3], "wb").write(image)
    lost = [a for a in range(0x93000, end, SECTOR) if backup[a:a + SECTOR] != BLANK]
    print(f"package image 0x{FW_START:05X}-0x{end - 1:05X} laid over the backup")
    if lost:
        print("it covers data the installed firmware had stored at:", ", ".join(f"0x{a:05X}" for a in lost))
```
